name: unpack
cmd: mkdir -p /tmp/track-p-current && tar -xJf research/track-p/input/current-integrated.tar.xz -C /tmp/track-p-current && bun -e 'import {readFileSync} from "node:fs"; const p="/tmp/track-p-current/", fresh=JSON.parse(readFileSync(p+"family-first.json","utf8")), old=JSON.parse(readFileSync("research/track-p/input/production.json","utf8")); console.log(JSON.stringify({sameMachine:JSON.stringify(fresh.machine)===JSON.stringify(old.machine),sameLaws:JSON.stringify(fresh.laws)===JSON.stringify(old.laws),freshLaws:fresh.laws.length})); console.log("CURRENT_PRODUCTION "+JSON.stringify(fresh));'
